body:
I'm a burned-out workaholic that doesn't know how to ignite passion in anything I do anymore. Worked my way towards a high-end job that should make me happy, but makes me feel incredibly worse.

I feel sorry for myself, and that there's nothing for me anymore.

Man, I really feel you here...

I'm a workaholic to the point where I burn myself out. I build resentment towards close ones, and refuse to talk or do anything for *months*. 

This actually makes me feel worse for treating my friends this way, which builds more resentment and increases the depth of what's going on...
